## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 📱 Environment & Hardware
- **Device**: [e.g. iPad Mini 1 (A1432), iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad 4]
- **iOS Version**: [e.g. 9.3.5]
- **Jailbreak Tool**: [e.g. Phoenix, p0linx, Home Depot, none]
- **NavigatorOSM Version**: [e.g. 1.3.3]
- **GPS Source**: [e.g. Internal Apple GPS, Android GPSTether UDP, TCP]

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Tap on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## 📸 Screenshots or Logs
If applicable, add screenshots, syslog / crash reporter logs to help explain the problem.

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. language set in app, network connection type).
